method: Expanded-trained LR applied to held-out KM 792 isolates (zero overlap with expanded training). Compare to golden-production KM AUC 0.868.
interpretation: Expanded model external KM AUC 0.8636 vs golden production 0.8682 (delta -0.0046). Tests whether richer training improves generalization to unseen isolates.
caveats: KM assay undocumented (MEDIUM); 35 R -> wide CI; sensitivity analysis. No tuning; KM excluded from expanded training. match != beat.
supports: External generalization benefit of richer training data.
